coverage.reason: Apply these bounds independently to every listed role and field. Long-lived means observed lifetime at least 1 s, with at least two valid required reads. Frontend/controller/endpoint also require one valid read for a shorter window. Short helpers retain launch/wait/reap or first-observed limits and only genuinely sampled values. Calibration supports the unchanged 0.3 s startup and 0.5 s maximum blind interval; CPU remains optional with every gap disclosed.

calibration.evidence_path_scope: relative to campaign workspace, not repository
calibration.rule_rationale: Each role and field is evaluated independently. Required fields must be observed during the 0.3 s startup window, then no blind interval may exceed 0.5 s. Calibration first reads were within 0.058 s and every required gap below 0.133 s. The finite blind window permits isolated classified misses but refuses persistent owner blindness; later absence never repairs a past gap. No overall percentage is used.
limits: Two-second synthetic role windows do not certify loaded-host or long-run behavior.
Nominal cadence is 0.1 s; actual intervals, lag and overhead remain reported.
Original request/UI deadlines and sampled resource ceilings are unchanged.
